It was introduced to address the limitations of NeRF, which uses a density field that does not explicitly represent a surface, leading to blurry reconstructions.
By replacing density with a Signed Distance Field (SDF) and adding Eikonal regularization, NeuS enables the extraction of high-quality meshes.
